notes.title: Patch 1.0.3
notes.content:
Patch Notes 1.0.3

-Changed the way the Tech UI displays the current research

-Made it so various things now update without the need to close and reopen windows

-Corrected error message received when trying to found a city over water

-Fixed a situation where a Spy could prevent advancing the turn

-Various improvements to UI quality and default settings

-Fixed an issue with Freighters picking up and dropping off

-Fixed tooltip to show exact amount of time until Siege ends

-Tutorial panes will now pop up immediately by default

-Fixed issues with scaling of images in the Tutorial panes

notes.title: Hotfix v1.0.2
notes.content:
The support, feedback, and encouragement we've received since the full release of Xenia's Ark has been inspiring. And though this Hot Fix patch did not come as quickly as we would have liked, with your help we were able to identify and include more bug fixes and changes. While we are confident these changes will make Xenia's Ark more enjoyable, we know there's still work to do to make it the best game it can be. And thanks again for jumping through the wormhole with us.

Now, let's embark,

Malicious Games Dev Team

V1.0.2 Patch Notes

Bugfixes
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where you were prompted to pay for development of a district tile when that district was already developing a tile
[*] Fixed a bug where the option to pay for development was not always available
[*] Fixed a bug where building upgrades were not showing in the production options when the technology was unlocked
[*] Fixed a bug where some Leader traits were not being correctly applied
[*] Fixed a bug where the name of techs were not showing when proposing a research agreement through the diplomacy screen
[*] Fixed a bug where the routes UI wasn’t updating if open while configuring a route with the route configuration UI
[*] Fixed a bug where you could not begin development of a district tile if a tile improvement had been built on that tile
[*] Fixed a bug where a spy did not vacate a city when the city was taken over by another player
[*] Fixed a bug where the route configuration UI was not always being updated when closing the UI and opening it to configure a different route
[*] Fixed a bug where freighters would not use all their movement points after changing maps when advancing on a route
[*] Fixed a bug where freighters would leave their starting hub without collecting cargo after a route was first established
[*] Fixed a bug where maximum allowed research contribution was not always displayed for a research agreement
[*] Fixed some typos in various tooltips
[*] Fixed a bug where clicking the Leader portrait on the Unit UI did not select the Leader that was assigned to command that Military Unit
[/list]

notes.title: Patch - Hotfix 1.0.1
notes.content:
[u][b]Patch Notes -- Hotfix 1.0.1[/b][/u]

First, we would like to thank all the players who have sent in feedback, bug reports, and posted reviews over the past week, as we have been hard at work to bring you the first Patch post release, Hotfix 1.0.1. 
     We came to realize, rather quickly, that we had underestimated the learning curve for new players. To this end, we have added a button to the in-game UI that will bring you to the Xenia's Ark Wiki, which is still being updated with more information. 
     Credits were a bit harder to come by than we anticipated, so we have made a couple alterations that should allow for an easier time in the early game in that regard. 
     And finally, a very special thanks to all of you who submitted bug reports. We got quite a lot of squashing done, and thanks to you, the game is more enjoyable for everyone. We are continuing to listen to your feedback as we keep working to make Xenia's Ark as great as it can be. 


See you on the Ark,

-Malicious Dev Team

[b][u]Balance Changes and Bug Fixes[/u][/b]

	• Markets now provide 5 credits instead of 2.

	• Wild Growth now yields 1 Credit, 1 Food, instead of 2 Food

	• Added a link to the Xenia's Ark wiki in the main screen UI, next to the Main Menu button.

	• Fixed an issue where Leaders were not always applying their bonuses when assigned as Governor. 

	• Fixed an issue where District Development Expansions would reset when the City expanded

	• Fixed an issue where players could pay to develop an already developed District tile.
	
	• Fixed an issue where rebuilding a collapsed building would result in wonkiness

	• Fixed an issue where players would get stuck waiting for themselves

	• Fixed an issue where tile improvements on the Star System map would become unpowered even though the nearest Star Base had enough energy.

notes.title: Early Access February Patch
notes.content:
As we push for full release, we are pleased to announce the End Game scenario now going live. Along with:

-New special effects and animations added
-AI improvements
-Quality of Life Improvements
-Various bugfixes

Due to the many and various changes made with this patch, it is unlikely that any save game files from before this patch will continue to work. We encourage players to start a new game after updating to this version. 

As always, we thank you all for your comments, feedback, and help in making Xenia's Ark a success!
